					EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$

					EXPECTED_STATE = 5
					EXPECTED_CHOICE = 2
				}
				zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m263_receipt_owner
					RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m263_receipt_subject
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m263_receipt_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m263_receipt_case
					RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m263_receipt_state
					RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m263_receipt_choice
					EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					EXPECTED_STATE = 5
					EXPECTED_CHOICE = 3
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_last_red_code value = 2639 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 4 } # route collision typed RED
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 3 } } # stale no-op
}
